prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps and changing finish layouts consistently hurt performance across tests.
Adoption new screens proved helpful, producing a winning test with consistent positive direction.
Adoption new flows consistently hurt performance across multiple tests.
Home wait-info and adoption copy showed no clear effect, producing no winning tests despite wait-info leaning positive.
Evidence remains thin for changes tested only once or lacking clear agreement across tests (such as redesigns, hints, and layout variations outside finish).
Predictions were generally too high for failing tests, while negative predictions were too low for winning tests.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] pick_friend_habitat_preview_new_screen: Adds a new habitat selection screen right after pick_friend allowing users to select a desktop background theme for their companion. (why: Adoption new screens have consistently improved onboarding conversion in previous tests, and users benefit from early customization.)
1: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_protection_reassurance: Adds a explicit hint on sign_in clarifying that signing in backs up pets permanently to prevent progress loss. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after sign in; clear sign-in reassurance targets the 27.1% sign-in drop-off.)
2: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_sound_preview_redesign: Redesigns pick_friend into a spotlight layout featuring interactive audio sound previews for each pet choice. (why: Adoption conversion is 69.6% with long median times (89s); interactive feedback increases pet attachment during adoption.)
3: [choose_path, hint] choose_path_journey_preview_card: Adds a quick-start duration hint on choose_path letting users know setup takes less than two minutes. (why: The choose_path mean duration is extremely long at 514s (median 8s), suggesting decision hesitation for some users.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] upload_photos_style_preset_new_screen: Inserts a new screen for choosing rendering style presets when creating or custom-styling a pet photo. (why: Adoption new screens have proven effective, and support noted 3 issues with custom pet rendering quality.)
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_placement_preview: Shows a live visual placement preview of where the pet will anchor on the screen while waiting for adoption processing. (why: Home waiting has a high mean time of 1017s and support had 3 tickets about pets failing to show up on desktop.)
6: [choose_path, redesign] story_mascot_intro_redesign: Redesigns the initial story welcome into a stage layout with a greeting mascot introducing the app concept. (why: Engaging visual narrative upfront helps speed up initial decision making and reduces choose_path drop-off.)
7: [finish, hint] home_intro_dock_visibility_hint: Adds explicit instructions on home_intro showing how to locate and toggle pet controls from the system tray. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and overall onboarding completion is only 21.4%.)
8: [sign_in, incentive] sign_in_social_quick_auth_incentive: Adds an cloud backup badge on sign_in highlighting instant cross-device account protection. (why: Addressing account sync concerns directly targets the 8 support emails about missing pets after sign-in.)
